library.fileReplayHint: Upload or remove clips, start/stop the processor, and watch progress. The clips folder is fixed in hub configuration (not editable here). Cameras stay in Settings → Connection.
library.fileReplaySetupIntro: Enabling switches the processor to file mode and restarts it. Clips folder path comes from hub configuration only (not editable here). Use the loop switch in this card before enabling.
library.fileReplayReturnLiveConfirm: Switch video source back to Go2RTC and restart the processor? Your camera list in Settings is unchanged.
library.fileReplaySetupFolderInfo: Clips folder (from hub configuration): {{path}}. It cannot be changed from this screen.
library.fileReplayRestartFail: Settings may be saved but processor restart failed.
library.fileReplayConfigSaveFail: Could not save settings or restart.
library.fileReplayAdminOnlyMode: Only an admin session can switch video mode.
library.fileReplayLoopHint: Before you enable file mode, this value is saved as the default loop flag. With file mode on: while replay is running, changes go to the processor immediately; when stopped, the next Start uses the switch.
library.fileReplayLoadError: Could not load file replay status
library.fileReplayActionError: Action failed — check admin access and that disk replay mode is still enabled.
library.fileReplayUploadLimitHint: Typical upload limit about {{max}} MiB (hub setting). A reverse proxy in front may enforce a smaller cap (HTTP 413).
library.fileReplayUploadLimitHintGeneric: Upload size is limited. If you get 413, use a smaller file or raise limits on the hub and reverse proxy (e.g. nginx client_max_body_size).
library.fileReplayUpload413: 413: request body too large. Hub config currently allows about {{max}} MiB per upload (video.file_test_max_upload_mb). If your file is clearly smaller, the reverse proxy (e.g. nginx client_max_body_size) is usually the limit.
library.fileReplayUpload413Proxy: 413: response looks like a proxy block (nginx, etc.), not hub JSON — raise client_max_body_size on the location that serves /api/ (often must be ≥ your file size). Status currently shows about {{max}} MiB from YAML; the real cut-off can be lower if the proxy rejects first.
library.fileReplayUpload413Generic: Request body too large (HTTP 413). Try a smaller file or raise upload limits on the reverse proxy and hub.
library.fileReplayLiveSummary: At a glance: phase {{phase}} · file {{file}} · clip {{index}}/{{total}} · frames {{frames}}
library.fileReplayFramesHint: This counter rises while the processor decodes the current clip (the hub refreshes it a few times per second during a run). «—» only when there is no status yet.
library.datasetFlowIntro: Typical path: import recordings → regenerate tracks if needed → export dataset. Spectrograms are not required for crops or training; use them only if you rely on the BirdNET-over-MQTT flow and want updated spectrogram images. Retro-export and clean-dataset are optional maintenance, not part of the minimal loop.
library.datasetFlowStep1: Import: "Scan and import" picks up new files under the recordings archive.
library.datasetFlowStep2: Period and filters: set the date range above; for tracks you can limit species so only videos that already have those detections are queued.
library.datasetFlowStep3: Tracks: "Regenerate tracks" when detections/bboxes in the DB must be rebuilt (after setting changes or bad frames). Large archives: run overnight and slice by period.
library.datasetFlowStep4: Crops on disk: use "Retro-export" from saved detections if needed, then "Export dataset" (ZIP). "Clean dataset" only when you intentionally remove bad or orphaned files under train/.
library.recordingsCalendarSubtitle: This calendar shows real files on disk, not processor heartbeat.
library.recordingsLoadFailed: Failed to load recordings archive stats.
library.recordingsOpenDayHint: Click a highlighted day to open recordings and detections for that date.
library.datasetToolsSubtitle: Dataset preparation and archive maintenance now live directly in Library so the whole workflow stays in one place.
library.datasetToolsLibraryHint: Scan/import, DB maintenance, backup/restore, and storage overview are available below on this same page.
library.datasetExportStarted: Dataset archive is ready and the download has started.
library.maintenanceMovedToSystem: Archive, dataset, and database operations are grouped on the Library page so the operator workflow stays consistent.

overview.errorLoad: Error loading data. Check that the API is available.
overview.checkApi: Check: open /api/ui/health in browser — should return {status: ok}.
overview.bySourceHint: How many visits include at least one segment from this provider. Row sums can exceed total visits when one visit merged multiple sources.
overview.volunteerDataLabelingHint: Volunteers can help with data labeling — contact us.
overview.uniqueSpeciesHint: Distinct bird species with detections on the selected day
overview.totalVisitsHint: Number of visits (SpeciesVisit sessions) on the selected day. A visit may include multiple clips and multiple recognition segments.
overview.visitsLastHourHint: Visits overlapping the last 60 minutes from now (same clock as the API).
overview.meanDurationHint: Average length of video clips recorded that day
overview.busiestHourHint: Local observer hour when the most visits started
overview.recordingTimeHint: Sum of all video file durations for the day
overview.weatherLoadError: Could not load weather. The rest of the overview is shown.
overview.regionComparisonDesc: {{userCount}} species in the dataset. {{matchCount}} of them are in the region's top {{regionTop}}.
overview.regionComparisonMatched: Species from the dataset in the regional top:
overview.regionComparisonHint: Based on eBird data for the last 30 days. Region: {{region}}.
overview.regionComparisonConfigure: Add eBird API key in Settings → Advanced for regional comparison.
overview.regionComparisonNoData: No observations in region {{region}} in the last 30 days. Check eBird country/state in settings.
overview.regionComparisonMoved: Regional top and overlap moved to the Migration page.

settings.section1Desc: MQTT and Go2RTC — base for cameras, motion detection and relays.
settings.section2Desc: Camera names from Go2RTC/Frigate. Frigate and BirdNET topics are standard. Camera filter is taken from the list below.
settings.section3Desc: With MQTT, Frigate and BirdNET events feed detection merge. Recording starts from the trigger you pick: usually camera motion (OpenCV), optionally Frigate MQTT, a standalone MQTT sensor, or ESPHome. BirdNET is not a record trigger (merge/thresholds only).
settings.section4Desc: Dispense, scales, and relay: «Dispense Feed», MQTT/ESPHome, scale integration.
settings.section5Desc: Telegram bot to channel or chat. Species exclusions.
settings.section6Desc: OpenWeather or Home Assistant — weather source for Overview, Timeline, and video details.
settings.section7Desc: Password for settings and system operations access.
settings.section8Desc: Model Context Protocol — external tools can call BirdLense Hub API.
settings.mcpHint: Container restart required after enabling. URL: /mcp
settings.advancedDesc: YOLO (bird detection) is used in processor — models in processor.models config. Here only recording params and filters.
settings.accordionMotionDesc: Default: camera motion (OpenCV). Frigate (MQTT), MQTT binary, or ESPHome are optional. With Frigate+MQTT, OpenCV may run in parallel as a safety net. BirdNET joins merge logic, not the record start.
settings.accordionHomeAssistantDesc: Shared URL and Long-Lived Access Token for every feature that calls the Home Assistant REST API (weather from a weather.* entity, feeder scale when source is HA, and future integrations).
settings.haEnvOverrideHint: When HA_URL or HA_TOKEN is set in the environment, those values override the fields below.
settings.haTokenHint: Create under your HA user profile (Long-Lived Access Tokens).
settings.accordionWeatherDesc: Weather source and coordinates for Overview.
settings.accordionIntegrationsDesc: Xeno-canto API key and MCP (enable, token). eBird and Home Assistant are separate sections above; weather is under Notifications → Weather & Location. Feeder scales: Video → Feeder.
settings.accordionEbirdDesc: API key, region, and species mapping for eBird checklist export.
settings.passwordServerError: Server error. Please try again later.
settings.settingsLoadFailed: Failed to load settings. Log in again or check your connection.
settings.loaded: Settings loaded. Fields showing *** have values set (secrets are masked).
settings.settingsPasswordHint: Protects settings access. Set in user_config.yaml or here.
settings.contributorPasswordHint: Species correction, reports, iNaturalist. No access to feed or settings.
settings.sessionIdleMinutesHint: After this many minutes without API activity, the login session ends. 0 disables the timeout. Default 30. Admin-only when a contributor password is configured.
settings.yamlBackupDesc: Safe export masks secrets (***). Full YAML includes secrets for backup/restore (administrators only). Import merges into user_config.yaml and creates .bak; restart processor if needed.
settings.yamlBackupDescSafeOnly: Download without secrets: keys and passwords appear as placeholders (***). Use when you need to share the config shape without leaking credentials.
settings.yamlFullConfirm: Full YAML contains raw secrets. Download only for backup on a trusted device. Continue?
settings.yamlImportOk: Settings imported. Restart processor if required.
settings.streamNameHint: Stream name from Go2RTC. Name for Live label.
settings.mqttBrokerHint: IP or domain of broker (Frigate, Tasmota, sensors)
settings.frigateTopicHint: Frigate events for merging with YOLO
settings.frigateLabelExcludeHint: Labels to ignore (mouse misidentified as cat/dog). Comma-separated.
settings.frigateMotionIntro: Frigate MQTT events (see Connection) start recording and take part in fusion. Below: filters and geometry fallback trigger.
settings.frigateRoutingDesc: Empty camera list = only cameras configured under Video (same as unset). Empty label list = any label (noisier). Excluded labels are not merged as Frigate species, but with geometry fallback recording may still start.
settings.frigateCameraFilterHint: Comma-separated. Empty = same IDs as in Video → Cameras (not every camera on the MQTT broker).
settings.frigateLabelFilterHint: e.g. bird, squirrel, animal. Empty = any label (noisier).
settings.frigateTriggerOnGeometry: Fallback: start recording on tracked box if label not in list
settings.frigateTriggerOnGeometryHint: If MQTT payload has coordinates but label fails the filter, still start recording (Frigate is already tracking).
settings.frigateFusionDesc: Post-track thresholds, merge windows, and Frigate-only fallback when YOLO produced no track (e.g. light gate on). “Unknown” from Frigate is usually an unmapped label — add **detection.species_mapping** (Frigate label → Rodent / species). Restart processor after changes.
settings.detectionMinConfidenceToStore: Min confidence to keep after merge
settings.detectionMinConfidenceToStoreHint: Detections below are dropped at finalize (0–1). Keep aligned with classifier threshold.
settings.detectionMergeWindowHint: How wide MQTT events are tied to clip time.
settings.detectionDedupWindowHint: Gap after which same species counts as a new visit.
settings.detectionOnePerSpecies: One result per species per clip
settings.detectionOnePerSpeciesHint: Collapse multiple rows of the same species into one.
settings.detectionCrossSourceBonus: Confidence bonus on first MQTT merge
settings.detectionCrossSourceBonusHint: One-time add when a YOLO row first merges with Frigate in-window (capped at 1.0).
settings.frigateStandaloneHeading: Fallback: Frigate visit without YOLO track
settings.frigateStandaloneWhenNoYolo: Create visit if YOLO had no track but Frigate sent an event
settings.frigateStandaloneWhenNoYoloHint: Otherwise Frigate-triggered clips are often deleted as zero detections. Tune thresholds below or disable notify to limit noise.
settings.frigateStandaloneMinScoreHint: Lower = more clips saved, higher false positives. 0 not recommended.
settings.frigateStandaloneMissingFallbackHint: 0 = off. Use for snapshots/payloads without top_score.
settings.frigateStandaloneNotifyHint: Off = save to DB without chat photo (like excluded labels). Global min_confidence_to_notify still applies.
settings.frigateStandaloneExcludedIntro: Visit is stored with Frigate label (e.g. Cat) without Telegram and without YOLO species merge — for manual relabeling.
settings.frigateStandaloneExcludedMinScoreHint: Usually 0 — accept with imputation below when score is missing.
settings.absorbGenericBird: Collapse generic Bird with confident species
settings.absorbGenericBirdHint: If the same clip has a specific species above classifier threshold — single result.
settings.absorbGenericBirdOverlapHint: How much Bird and species intervals must overlap.
settings.absorbGenericBirdMinClassifierHint: Below this, Bird is not absorbed into that species.
settings.mqttPublishTopicHint: Where Hub publishes merged detections (for HA automations and integrations)
settings.mqttReconnectMinDelayHint: Minimum delay before reconnect after disconnect
settings.mqttHaDiscoveryHint: Publish configs so HA auto-discovers Last Species, Bird at Feeder, etc.
settings.birdnetUrlHint: URL to BirdNET-Pi/Go. Empty — icon hidden.
settings.heimdallUrlHint: Heimdall does not auto-import BirdLense entities: this field is only for the Hub → Heimdall reachability probe (System page). To open BirdLense from Heimdall, add a manual bookmark/tile to your hub URL; for metrics use /metrics (System → Observability). For Docker, the hostname must resolve from the Hub container.
settings.donateUrlHint: Opens when users tap the single heart icon in the top bar (next to language / settings). Not shown on the Food card or in the gear menu.
settings.accordionPerformanceDesc: Redis TTL cache for heavy API responses. In Docker, Redis runs by default; you can turn it off or set a custom URL.
settings.performanceRedisEnabledHint: Off — in-process memory only (ignores REDIS_URL from the environment).
settings.performanceRedisUrlHint: Empty — REDIS_URL from the environment is used. If set, overrides the environment. Saved passwords are masked in the API.
settings.encodingHint: Intel — VA-API on any Intel integrated GPU. Requires /dev/dri/renderD128 in container.
settings.recordStreamCodecCopy: Copy from stream (fast, may be HEVC)
settings.recordStreamCodecHint: H.264 re-encodes on CPU when encoding is «cpu»; Intel GPU path already outputs H.264. New recordings only — old clips keep their codec.
settings.videoFileModeActiveHint: Processor is in disk replay mode. Cameras below are not used until you return to live in
settings.videoFilePathHint: Absolute path inside container, e.g. /app/data/file_test/clip.mp4 (default compose mounts host ./data to /app/data)
settings.videoFileDirHint: If file path is empty: all *.mp4/*.mov/*.mkv directly in this folder (not subfolders), sorted. In Docker use a path under /app/data/… (e.g. /app/data/file_test). Restart from the first file only if “Loop playback” is enabled.
settings.videoFileLoopHint: On — playback restarts after end of file.
settings.triggerHint: Pick one recording trigger. Frigate works only when MQTT events are actually arriving.
settings.motionCheckEveryNFramesHint: OpenCV only: 1 = every frame, 3 = every 3rd. Reduces CPU load at high FPS.
settings.mqttSensorAlert: MQTT sensor: subscribe to topic. On ON/1 — record. Tasmota: stat/NAME/STATE or stat/NAME/PIR.
settings.mqttTopicHint: Topic where ON is published on motion
settings.esphomeAlert: ESPHome: binary sensor (PIR, door). Requires web_server in ESPHome config.
settings.sensorIdHint: id from YAML: binary_sensor: - id: bird_pir
settings.feedMqttHint: MQTT broker — in Connection section. Below only relay topic.
settings.esphomeFeedHint: IP and name from ESPHome config. Switch — relay (turn_on/turn_off). Button — button (press, duration on device). Important: ESPHome YAML must have web_server:, otherwise REST API (404) won't work.
settings.switchIdHint: ID from YAML: switch: - id: bird_feeder. Must match object_id.
settings.webhookUrlHint: POST on each detection (IFTTT, Zapier). JSON: species, confidence, time, source
settings.galleryEnabled: Upload best frames to community site (opt-in)
settings.galleryUploadUrlHint: multipart/form-data: image, species, confidence, timestamp, latitude, longitude
settings.webPushDesc: Browser push notifications for detections (alternative or addition to Telegram).
settings.telegramChatIdHint: e.g. -1001234567890. Add bot as channel admin.
settings.refreshTelegramProxyHint: Find a working Telegram SOCKS5 proxy and save it into settings.
settings.telegramProxyTypeHint: No keys from my.telegram.org? Use «SOCKS5 / HTTP» or «No proxy» — api_id not required. MTProto only if you have api_id+api_hash from Telegram’s site.
settings.telegramProxyUrlHint: For «SOCKS/HTTP»: e.g. socks5h://127.0.0.1:9050 or http://127.0.0.1:8118 — tunnel to api.telegram.org.
settings.telegramMtprotoSecretHint: Hex string from the Telegram app (often starts with ee or dd). Masked in the API.
settings.telegramMtprotoApiHint: MTProto needs api_id and api_hash from https://my.telegram.org → API development tools (or TELEGRAM_API_ID / TELEGRAM_API_HASH in the container .env). If the Telegram site shows an error: try VPN, another browser, mobile data, or later — my.telegram.org is often flaky from some networks.
settings.telegramApiIdHint: Integer from my.telegram.org (not the bot token).
settings.telegramApiHashHint: String from my.telegram.org; masked in the API.
settings.telegramApiBaseHint: Empty — https://api.telegram.org. Alternative: reverse proxy that forwards to Telegram.
settings.telegramTimeoutHint: 30–600. Higher values help on slow or blocked networks. Text messages use half this value.
settings.telegramRetriesHint: 1–5 attempts on timeout or connection errors.
settings.telegramMaxSidePxHint: 0 — do not resize. Downscales large crops before send.
settings.telegramThreadIdHint: Empty — no topics. For forum channel — topic ID.
settings.paidMediaForwardStarsHint: When view free: 0 — allow, >0 — block. When view paid — forward included.
settings.weatherHint: Weather: Overview, Timeline, video details. Saved with each recording. Coordinates — below.
settings.postRecordSecondsHint: Added to «seconds without activity» before stopping the clip. 0 = off.
settings.processorMultiCameraBirdnetDesc: Frigate camera IDs in a line = one location. BirdNET bias lowers classifier threshold for species recently heard on MQTT.
settings.multiCameraGroups: Cameras at the same location (Frigate IDs)
settings.multiCameraGroupsHint: One group per line; cameras comma-separated (must match Frigate camera names). Empty = disabled.
settings.multiCameraConfidenceBoostHint: Added to merged confidence when the same species appears on two or more cameras in one group (0–0.5).
settings.birdnetMqttAutoConfidence: Lower classifier threshold from recent BirdNET MQTT
settings.birdnetMqttAutoConfidenceHint: Uses BirdNET topic from Connection. Restart processor after changes.
settings.birdnetMqttBiasWindowHint: Priority comes from the ~24h BirdNET FIFO below. This only widens lookback from clip start when priors are empty.
settings.birdnetMqttBiasDeltaHint: For auto BirdNET species (manual overrides win).
settings.serviceScalesDesc: When enabled and configured, the UI shows current weight. Per-recording weight estimate is a separate option (MQTT topic + sample log). Starting capture and recognition from a weight spike is another option and adds to Frigate, motion (OpenCV), and other triggers — it does not replace them.
settings.scalesSourceHint: For the HA entity source, configure URL and token under Settings → Home Assistant.
settings.scalesHaEntityHint: e.g. sensor.smart_scale_weight — state must be numeric.
settings.scalesHaProcessorHint: The hub uses Home Assistant REST only for the current weight in the feeder card. Per-clip weight estimate, JSONL history, and "start recording on weight change" are implemented in the processor via MQTT: it must see every reading on a subscribed topic. For those features, choose MQTT as the source and set the same topic your integration publishes (often homeassistant/sensor/<id>/state). HA polling in the processor is not implemented yet.
settings.scalesMqttTopicHint: Plain number or JSON with value/weight/state. Example: homeassistant/sensor/your_scale_weight/state (ESPHome). Leave empty if you use the topic prefix below.
settings.scalesMqttPrefixHint: If set, the processor subscribes to {prefix}/weight, {prefix}/bird_present (ON/OFF), and uses {prefix}/command for the tare button. Example: birdlense/scale. Overrides implicit weight topic only when the field above is empty.
settings.scalesWeightEstimateHint: Store scale delta for the clip window (MQTT topic required). Only when the clip has a frame/track detection, not BirdNET-only (audio helps species ID, not feeder weight). By default requires a spike between consecutive samples (see below).
settings.scalesEstimateRequireSpike: Require a weight spike between consecutive MQTT samples
settings.scalesEstimateRequireSpikeHint: Off: span (max−min) over the clip is enough. On (recommended): no estimate unless some adjacent step ≥ threshold — fewer false positives from drift; tared empty platform stays near zero.
settings.scalesMotionTrigger: Start recording and recognition from weight (in addition to motion and Frigate)
settings.scalesMotionTriggerHint: A weight spike on MQTT starts the same pipeline as a Frigate or motion (OpenCV) trigger. Other triggers stay active. Requires MQTT broker and weight topic. Not used when motion source is PIR.
settings.scalesMotionMinDeltaHint: Between two consecutive messages on the weight topic.
settings.minTrackDurationHelp: ByteTrack tracks shorter than this are discarded. Default 1s — fewer spurious tracks near the feeder.
settings.confidenceThresholdsDesc: Classifier gates saving to DB; Telegram uses its own minimum so weak IDs can be archived without spam.
settings.confidenceDetectorHelp: Repo default **30%** (`min_confidence_binary`, first-stage YOLO). Higher = fewer false boxes / empty clips.
settings.confidenceClassifierHelp: Repo default **40%** (`min_confidence_to_process`). After voting × EU classifier; higher = fewer weak visits in DB.
settings.confidenceTelegramHelp: Repo default **46%** (`min_confidence_to_notify`). Photo alerts at or above; can set above classifier to reduce chat noise.
settings.confidenceDatasetHelp: Repo default **58%** (`dataset_min_confidence`) — which crops go to train.
settings.yoloSplitThresholdsDesc: Avoid one global squeeze: stricter **Bird** boxes, softer **Squirrel** (mouse/squirrel). Empty field = use the shared detector threshold. Area cap skips species classifier on tiny Bird blobs (fewer false tits on mice).
settings.confidenceBinaryBirdHelp: Above the base threshold = fewer false birds at dusk. YOLO track uses min of thresholds; Bird boxes are filtered with this value.
settings.confidenceBinarySquirrelHelp: Lower than Bird so small rodents are not dropped when the binary head labels them Squirrel.
settings.birdSkipClassifierArea: Max Bird area without species (fraction of frame)
settings.birdSkipClassifierAreaHelp: e.g. **0.018** = 1.8% of frame: smaller boxes skip the EU classifier and stay generic Bird (not “tit”). **0** or empty = off. Too high hurts small tits.
settings.lightGateDesc: If the frame is too dark or flat, YOLO is skipped to save CPU. Night/IR feeds often fail the contrast check — then tracks stay empty while Frigate/BirdNET still create species rows.
settings.lightGateEnabledHelp: Turn off to always run YOLO (more CPU, fixes “YOLO dead” on IR).
settings.lightGateMinBrightnessHelp: Below this, frames are skipped. Lower for dim scenes.
settings.lightGateMinContrastHelp: Below this, frames are skipped. IR often needs 8–12 instead of 20.
settings.falsePositiveGuardrailsDesc: Tighten the first-stage detector and generic fallback so feeder clutter is less likely to turn into fake birds.
settings.speciesConfidenceOverridesHint: Catalog name: threshold per line (e.g. **Rodent**: 0.28 for squirrels). Lower for rare species.
settings.minBoxSizePxHint: Reject tiny detector boxes that are often feeder debris or motion noise.
settings.detectorScopeHint: First-stage labels (Bird, Squirrel, …). In the **species catalog**, mammals are **Rodent** (EU classifier); search «Rodent», not «squirrel». Detector «Squirrel» maps to Rodent in fusion.
settings.classifierFallbackBirdHint: Disable to reject weak bird-like tracks instead of saving a generic Bird label.
settings.includedBirdFamiliesHint: Comma- or newline-separated families used by species filters. Leave empty to keep all families.
settings.ebirdRegionalTopConfidenceIntro: eBird regional top: optionally use a lower classifier threshold for species in your region’s recent top list (same source as Migration). Manual lines above always win.
settings.ebirdRegionalTopAutoConfidence: Auto lower threshold for regional top species
settings.ebirdRegionalTopAutoConfidenceHint: Requires eBird API key and ebird.country/state. Restart processor after changes.
settings.ebirdRegionalTopConfidenceDeltaHint: e.g. 0.05 → threshold = max(floor, min_confidence_to_process − 0.05) for each top species not listed manually.
settings.ebirdRegionalTopConfidenceFloorHint: Auto threshold is never below this value (0.0–1.0).
settings.unknownConfidenceThresholdHelp: Detections below go to «Unknowns». Repo default **0.48** (48%, `ui.unknown_confidence_threshold`).
settings.showTrackRegenControlsHelp: Heavy operation that re-runs detection on video. Off by default to avoid accidental overwrites.
settings.spectrogramDetailHelp: Pixels per second for the mel spectrogram image.
settings.generateSpectrogramAlwaysHelp: When off, a spectrogram is created only if a BirdNET MQTT event fell inside the recording window (saves CPU). When on, FFmpeg + librosa run after each finalized clip so the Audio tab always has an image when generation succeeds.
settings.saveDatasetCropsHelp: Best frames to data/dataset/train/<Species>. Export — Library → Recordings
settings.resolutionHint: Frame size for capture and recording. Affects quality and load.
settings.weatherHaAlert: Uses URL and token from Settings → Home Assistant. Here you only choose which weather.* entity to read (e.g. weather.home).
settings.xenoCantoApiKeyHint: For bird song playback on species pages. Get key at xeno-canto.org/account
settings.ebirdApiKeyHint: For regional comparison on Overview and species-mapping suggestions. Get at ebird.org/api/keygen
settings.ebirdSpeciesMappingHint: eBird (Gray) → BirdLense (Grey). One pair per line: eBird name: BirdLense name
settings.ebirdMappingSuggestNoKey: Configure the eBird API key above to load regional top species.
settings.ebirdMappingSuggestEmpty: All regional top names already match the catalog (after your current mapping).
settings.zipFetchFailed: Failed to fetch coordinates. Please check the ZIP code.
settings.restartInfo: After saving, the processor restarts automatically to apply changes.
settings.savedRestart: Settings saved. Processor will restart within ~60 seconds.
settings.saveError: Failed to save settings. Check your connection or try again.

live.title: Live — all cameras
live.noCameras: No cameras. Add in Settings → Video → Cameras (stream name from Go2RTC/Frigate).

timeline.intro: Camera recordings: select date and time to view videos with bird detections.
timeline.reportsAndSharingHint: eBird, CSV, and JSON export: open the menu from the download icon to the right of the species filter. iNaturalist: Share icon on a video detection row (visit card or recording detail). Monthly PDF report: Overview (home), next to the date picker.
timeline.noRecords: No records? If videos are on disk but not showing —

pwa.installPrompt: Add BirdLense Hub to your home screen

storage.scanHint: Add disk recordings to DB (after restart)
storage.title: Storage Management
storage.purgeHint: Deletes matching videos from the database and removes their recording folders. Requires admin unlock when a settings password is set.
storage.purgeConfirmRange: Delete all recordings from {{start}} through {{end}} (inclusive)? This cannot be undone.
storage.purgeConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete all recordings on or before {{date}}? This action cannot be undone.
storage.regenerateSpectrogramsHint: Generate spectrograms for old videos that don't have them (optional, for audio/visualization)
storage.trackRegenDisabledHint: Track regeneration is hidden. Turn on «Show track regeneration in Library» in Settings → Processor.
storage.regenerateTracksPeriodHelp: Only videos within this period will be processed.
storage.archiveRangeSummary: Archive on disk: {{start}} - {{end}} (calendar span {{spanDays}} days, {{recordedDays}} days with files, {{files}} files, {{size}}). The “All time” preset uses exactly this span.
storage.archiveRangeUnavailable: No archive range detected on disk yet. The “All time” preset becomes available after recordings appear.
storage.regenerateTracksEffectiveParams: Active settings: frame step {{step}}, {{px}} px, strategy {{strategy}}, timeout {{timeout}} s
storage.regenerateTracksSpeciesFilterActive: Species filter: {{count}} selected (only videos with those detections)
storage.regenerateTracksFullClassScope: Model classes: full scope (processor.regional_species ignored for this job)
storage.trackRegenSpeciesHint: List is built from tracks on videos (not visits only). Pick a species that already has rows on recordings: only those videos enter the queue. The model runs on the whole file; only selected species that actually get a new detection in this run are replaced (other selected species on that same file are not wiped). Unrelated species on the file are untouched.
storage.trackRegenSpeciesPeriodNote: With a species filter, the period for this button is the full span from storage stats (first–last day with files), not the narrow period above — so rare clips are not skipped.
storage.trackRegenSpeciesPeriodNoStats: Species filter is on, but storage stats are not loaded — the date range above is used. Widen it (e.g. «All») if the queue stays empty.
storage.strictQualityExport: Strict quality: abort if any class is below min size or data fails gates
storage.retroExportRebuildHint: Delete crops for period and re-extract only crops (guaranteed no full-frame)
storage.retroExportHint: Extract frames from all video detections into dataset (for corrected species)
storage.retroExportSuccessWithNoBbox: Saved {{saved}}, skipped {{skipped}} ({{skipped_no_bbox}} no bbox — full frame skipped)
storage.retroExportRebuildConfirm: Rebuild dataset for period? All crops for selected dates will be deleted and only crops re-extracted from videos.
storage.cleanDatasetHint: Remove suspected full-frame (by size and aspect ratio) and/or orphaned files
storage.cleanDatasetConfirm: Remove suspected full-frame from dataset? Files >800×600 with 16:9/4:3 aspect will be deleted.
storage.heavyOpsIntro: The “all time” range is safe, but runtime depends on archive size. The heaviest operations are:
storage.heavyOpsSpectrograms: Regenerate spectrograms: heavy video/audio pass; not needed for YOLO crop export.
storage.heavyOpsTracks: Regenerate tracks: the heaviest option because it walks video frames again.

storage.cleanOrphanedVisitsHint: Removes orphaned visits and syncs data. Fixes incorrect counts in calendars and species summaries after corrections.
storage.cleanOrphanedVisitsConfirm: Remove orphaned visits and sync species_id? This will fix counts in calendars and species views.
storage.mergeSpeciesConfirm: Merge duplicate species (e.g. Garrulus glandarius (Eurasian Jay) → Eurasian Jay)? This updates the database.
storage.mergeSpeciesSuccess: Merged {{count}} duplicate species into canonical names
storage.dbBackupRestoreHint: Download a backup before major updates. Restore replaces the current DB and creates a pre-restore backup on the server.
storage.dbRestoreConfirm: Replace the current database with "{{name}}"? A pre-restore backup will be saved on the server first.

common.loginRequiredForExport: Sign in to export data and reports

migrationCalendar.title: Migration Calendar
migrationCalendar.description: When each species typically appears at the feeder — from data accumulated in the hub. Rows and the Σ column list species for the selected period (no separate checklist). Period filters apply to the table only, not to the regional reference block below.
migrationCalendar.periodHint: Switch between year range and exact dates — only one mode is active at a time.
migrationCalendar.noData: No rows for these filters. Try another catalog segment or a wider period.
migrationCalendar.noObserved: No observed species for the selected period.
migrationCalendar.noDataset: No species from local dataset for the selected period.
migrationCalendar.noSpeciesInDb: No species in the catalog yet.
migrationCalendar.catalogEvidenceHint: "Observed" lists only species with visits. "Present in local dataset" lists species found in data/dataset folders. "Full EU catalog" lists all allowlist classes, including zero rows.
migrationCalendar.tableCaption: Species by month: visit counts per cell; last column is the row total.

unknowns.intro: Detections with low confidence for manual review. Correct the species or open the video to verify.
unknowns.confirmCorrectHelp: Species is correct — remove from list
unknowns.confirmBlockedPendingApply: A different species is selected — click Apply to save it, or clear the dropdown to confirm the current label.
unknowns.empty: No low-confidence detections for the selected period. Try another day or hour. Bird species always appears here for verification.
unknowns.limitReached: Showing up to 500 records. Select a specific hour for precise search.
unknowns.hourHint: When selecting a time (not 00:00), only detections for that hour are shown.

species.noSpeciesFilter: No species to display with the selected filter.

video.mergeAllHint: Different neural networks or interruptions created multiple cards — select the correct species and merge all detections.
video.timelineHint: Colored bars = species. Hover to see source: YOLO, Frigate, or BirdNET.
video.noTrackFramesHint: No YOLO bbox on this clip (overlay hidden). Defaults were tightened so birds stay in the recording; use Admin → “Rebuild tracks for this clip” or lower processor.min_track_duration / min_confidence_to_process in Settings.
video.tracksMissingHint: This clip has no per-frame boxes in the DB yet — rebuild tracks to make the overlay appear.
video.regenerateTracksThisVideoHelp: Admin only. Runs YOLO on this clip (CPU-heavy). Wait for the job to finish, then refresh. If boxes still missing, check hub logs for "Track regen" and reason (e.g. no_detections_fast_run, video_file_missing).
video.regenResultCheckLogs: If updated is 0, check hub logs (lines containing "Track regen").
video.regenResultTimeout: Job status did not arrive in time (it may still be running). Refresh in a minute.
video.regenDoneNoPayload: Job finished without details in the response. Refresh the page.
video.regenerateSpectrogramThisVideoHelp: Admin only. Rebuilds the spectrogram image from this clip (BirdNET). Wait for completion, then refresh.
video.specRegenDone: Spectrogram job finished. Refresh the page if needed.
video.speciesUnchanged: This species is already selected — nothing to update.
video.correctNoDetectionId: No video detection id for this card — refresh the page or check data.
video.neighborsDayHint: Local calendar day; can continue past midnight. Prev/next steps through all clips for that calendar day.

feed.relayNotConfigured: Feeder not configured. Set MQTT or ESPHome under Settings → Video → Feeder.
feed.adminOnly: Button available to admin. Volunteers can help with data labeling — contact us.

speciesSummary.noWeatherData: No weather data for sightings in the last 30 days.
speciesSummary.noDescription: Description is temporarily unavailable for this species.
speciesSummary.tuningMarked: This species is marked as a future fine-tuning target.
speciesSummary.refreshMetadataHint: Re-fetch image and description for this species only (requires Settings password). Fixes wrong photos without running full catalog repair.

fusionTrace.title: Fusion decision trace
fusionTrace.hint: Per-track path: detector → classifier → evidence → audio alignment → fusion flags → outcome. “Saved on clip” is what was persisted to the recording; “DecisionMaker accepted” is the DM flag (they can differ, e.g. Frigate standalone).
fusionTrace.noTrace: No decision trace is stored for this recording yet.
fusionTrace.noTraceDetail: Traces are written when the processor finalizes a clip with at least one track on the clip or in the reject list. Older hubs may only match on file path.

videoInfo.deleteConfirmText: The video file and all associated data will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
videoInfo.scalesEstimateHint: Change in scale readings during the clip when a video detection exists; wind, noise, or multiple birds affect accuracy.
videoInfo.visitSpeciesMismatch: Some detections are linked to a visit of a different species — often after manual DB edits or track regeneration. The video labels show what is stored on this clip.

system.processorLogsHint: Last {{lines}} lines. Auto-refresh every 10s. For remote diagnostics when you can't access docker logs.
system.processorWeightsIntro: Binary detector and species classifier are two different .pt files. Upload replaces files under data/custom_weights and updates user_config with absolute paths. After each upload or reset, the processor restart flag is set — use Restart processor or wait for the watchdog.
system.processorWeightsBinaryHint: Bird / object-of-interest vs background (default: models/detection/weights/best.pt in the image).
system.processorWeightsClassifierHint: Fine-grained species head (default: models/classification/weights/best.pt). Pair with a matching class_names.txt when class count differs.
system.processorWeightsAllowlistHint: One class per line (Scientific (Common) format). Should match the classifier output order when you use a custom classifier.
system.processorWeightsAckClassifier: I understand the risk: upload classifier without a fresh class_names.txt (allowlist file must exist on the server).
system.processorWeightsLoadError: Could not load processor weights status
system.processorWeightsError.allowlist_missing_: Upload class_names.txt first, or enable the risk acknowledgement checkbox, or fix species.catalog_allowlist_file so the file exists.
system.processorWeightsError.file_too_small: File too small for a checkpoint
system.processorWeightsError.no_class_lines: No non-empty class lines in file
system.liveTrendHint: Charts combine server-side samples (while the hub runs) with a short live tail from this page (polled every 5 s). They are not averages over the visitor period.
system.serverHistoryMeta: Chart window: last {{hours}} h. Server keeps up to {{retention}} h, sample interval ~{{interval}} s.
system.chartCollecting: Collecting points… stay on the page for a few polls.
system.errorLoadVisitors: Could not load site visitor statistics
system.encodingGpuUnavailable: Intel GPU is selected in settings but the device is not available in the container. Add devices to compose (see docker-compose.intel.example.yml).
system.gpuNoData: No GPU load data (sysfs and Intel probe unavailable). If Intel recording fails, switch to CPU in Settings → Video.
system.uniqueVisitorsHint: Estimate based on anonymous browsers over {{days}} day(s), without IPs or fingerprinting (active days: {{activeDays}}).
system.speciesVisitSessionsHint: Count of SpeciesVisit sessions over {{days}} day(s) (active days: {{activeDays}}).
system.configAuditHint: Quick review of key settings without SSH: proxy, gallery, mapping, and deprecated keys.
system.speciesDataQualityHint: Operator checklist: labels that look like mis-detections or duplicate names. Use it together with catalog diagnostics when cleaning data.
system.catalogDiagnosticsSummary: Optional tools — expand only when tuning data or models.
system.speciesDataQualityLoadError: Failed to load species data quality report
system.catalogTuningHint: Fine-tuning candidates are computed automatically: observed species absent in real local dataset folders.
system.catalogRepairLoadError: Failed to load catalog polish status
system.catalogRepairWhatItDoes: The “complete” percent only means each species has some image and description — not that the photo is the right bird. Polish fills empty fields from Wikipedia/iNaturalist, swaps Wikimedia thumbs when the CDN blocks the hub, and applies built-in image URL fixes (e.g. Eurasian Magpie). Cards that already have both fields are mostly left alone — low numbers in the report are normal.
system.catalogRepairLastRun: Last run: checked {{checked}}, metadata updated {{fixed}}, images replaced (iNat/CDN) {{swapped}}, allowlist-binomial preview updates {{science}}, incomplete left {{missing}}. Species list cache is cleared — refresh the catalog page.
system.automationHint: Run admin and operational workflows from the UI. Fusion export/eval and catalog maintenance all stay behind settings access.
system.automationDangerNote: Dangerous actions are grouped here intentionally. Bulk track regeneration is hidden: use the per-video track button instead.
system.automationAdminMaintenanceHint: These actions mutate catalog or registry data. Use them only when you understand the impact.
system.automationFusionExportHint: Build decision traces for offline training/calibration of the fusion layer.
system.automationFusionExportDownloadHint: Download the latest CSV export if it was already generated.
system.automationFusionEvalHint: Run calibration metrics on the export CSV and inspect fusion quality.
system.automationRegistrySeedHint: Populate the canonical species registry and aliases from the mapping file.
system.automationRegistryBackfillHint: Backfill existing Species rows with canonical taxon links.
system.automationRegistryEnrichHint: Asynchronously enrich species cards with metadata and images.
system.automationRegistryMaterializeHint: Create missing Species rows for the allowlist and optionally fill metadata.
system.automationMergeDuplicateSpeciesHint: Merge duplicate Species entries based on the mapping file.
system.automationSpeciesCatalogReconcileHint: Normalize and reconcile catalog data to remove drift.
system.automationBrokenVideosPurgePreviewHint: Count DB rows with missing, unreadable, or empty video files (dry run).
system.automationBrokenVideosPurgeBatchHint: Deletes up to 500 broken rows per click. Repeat until deletedCount is 0. You will be asked to confirm the purge phrase.
system.automationBrokenVideosPurgePrompt: Type the purge confirmation phrase exactly (see scan JSON: confirmation_phrase).
system.automationNoSpeciesVideosPurgePreviewHin: Count Video rows with zero VideoSpecies (often from folder scan import). Dry run only.

system.automationNoSpeciesVideosPurgePrompt: Type the confirmation phrase from the scan response (confirmation_phrase).

system.automationBirdnetFifoUnavailable: Snapshot unavailable (no data or processor not writing the queue).

overview.title: Bird Activity Overview
overview.description: View real-time and daily statistics about bird activity at your feeder. This dashboard provides key metrics, current weather conditions, and a 24-hour activity pattern visualization.

details.title: Activity Statistics
details.content: Track unique bird species visits, total detections, and last hour activity. The system counts both video and audio detections, distinguishing between different species using computer vision and audio analysis.

details.title: Visit Metrics
details.content: Monitor average visit duration and identify the busiest hour of bird activity. The system considers a continuous period of detections as a single visit, helping understand bird feeding patterns.

details.title: Audio/Video Ratio
details.content: Shows the proportion of birds detected through audio versus video. A ratio less than 1 means more video detections, while greater than 1 indicates more audio detections. This helps evaluate detector performance.

details.title: Weather Information
details.content: Current weather conditions that may affect bird activity, including temperature, cloud cover, humidity, and wind speed. Weather data is automatically updated and stored with each detection.

details.title: Daily Activity Pattern
details.content: A 24-hour circular visualization showing when different species visit the feeder. The chart uses color-coding to distinguish between species, with the length of each segment indicating the number of detections.

details.title: Date Selection
details.content: Use the date picker to view historical data for any specific day. This allows you to track patterns over time and compare activity levels across different dates.

food.title: Bird Food Management
food.description: Manage and track different types of food available in your bird feeder. The system uses this information to analyze which foods attract specific bird species.

details.title: Food Selection
details.content: Toggle which types of food are currently available in your feeder. Active foods will be associated with bird visits and help build feeding pattern data.

details.title: Food Catalog
details.content: A comprehensive list of common bird foods with details about which species they typically attract. Each food type includes an image, description, and recommended usage.

details.title: Usage Analytics
details.content: The system tracks which foods are present during bird visits, helping you understand which foods are most effective at attracting specific species.

details.title: Active Status
details.content: Use the checkboxes to indicate which foods are currently in your feeder. Only active foods will be associated with new bird detections.

details.title: Food Information
details.content:
Each food entry includes:
- Name and image for easy identification
- Detailed description of the food type
- List of bird species commonly attracted to this food
- Special handling or storage recommendations

details.title: Food Effectiveness
details.content: Through the bird detection system, you can track which foods are most successful at attracting your target species. This data helps optimize your feeding strategy.

library.title: Library
library.description: Review the real recordings archive, open the needed days, maintain the database, and prepare datasets from one place. Library now combines archive visibility, dataset flow, backup/restore, and dry-run maintenance actions.

details.title: What the calendar means
details.content: The calendar is built from real files under data/recordings, so highlighted days mean recordings exist on disk for that date.

details.title: Why this matters
details.content: This helps separate archive problems from detection problems. If a day is highlighted here but Overview or Timeline is empty, recordings exist but detections or visits are missing.

details.title: What stays in Library
details.content: This page now combines archive browsing, safe dataset actions, scan/import, backup/restore, dry-run maintenance, and storage overview so archive work stays in one place.

details.title: How the workflow is organized
details.content: Library is now the main operator page for archive, dataset, and database workflows. System remains focused on monitoring, logs, diagnostics, and observability.

details.title: Safe workflow
details.content: Start in Library to confirm recordings exist for the day, open the needed date, and then run scan/import, dry-run maintenance, backup/restore, or dataset export from the same context.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: View chronological history of bird visits to your feeder. Each visit shows detailed information about detected birds, including both video and audio observations.

details.title: Visit Controls
details.content:
Filter and navigate visits using:
- Date/time picker to select viewing period
- Species dropdown to filter by specific bird types
- Summary statistics showing unique species count, total visits, and total duration

details.title: Day navigation
details.content: Chevrons next to the date jump to the nearest day that has files in your recordings archive on disk (empty days are skipped). Choosing a date in the picker still opens that exact day.

details.title: Visit Information
details.content:
Each visit card displays:
- Bird species with image and name
- Number of birds seen simultaneously (shown with person icon)
- Visit duration in seconds (shown with clock icon)
- Temperature during the visit (shown with thermometer icon)
- Expandable view for detailed detection timeline

details.title: Detection Types
details.content:
Within each visit, detections are shown with:
- Video detections (camera icon) - Visual confirmation of birds
- Audio detections (microphone icon) - Bird calls and songs
- Confidence percentage for each detection
- Precise timestamp for every observation
- Duration in seconds for each detection

details.title: Visual Timeline
details.content:
The vertical timeline shows:
- Chronological sequence of visits with time markers
- Connected dots indicating continuous monitoring
- Expandable/collapsible visit details
- Clear separation between different visits

details.title: Detection Confidence
details.content:
Each detection shows confidence levels:
- Video detections typically show 95-100% confidence
- Audio detections may have varying confidence levels
- Green indicators for high confidence (100%)
- Blue indicators for good confidence (95% and above)

details.title: Weather Context
details.content: Temperature data is recorded for each visit to help correlate bird activity with weather conditions. This helps identify patterns in bird behavior related to environmental factors.

unknowns.title: Unknowns
unknowns.description: Review and correct low-confidence detections. Detections with confidence below the threshold (configurable in Settings) appear here for manual verification.

details.title: Purpose
details.content: Low-confidence detections may be misidentified. This page lets you verify and correct the species before they affect statistics.

details.title: Threshold
details.content: Threshold: Settings → Processor → «More» / advanced block → «Unknowns threshold». Repo default **0.48** (below 48% lands here).

details.title: Correcting Species
details.content: Select the correct species from the dropdown and click Apply. Requires settings password if configured.

details.title: View Video
details.content: Click "View video" to open the recording and verify the detection visually before correcting.

details.title: Same correction as video page
details.content: Apply here updates the same detection record as correcting under Video details → Detected species (one underlying API). Use View video when you want to see the clip first.

details.title: Period Selection
details.content: By default, the full day is shown. When you select a time (not 00:00), only detections for that hour are displayed — useful when there are many records.

migrationCalendar.title: Migration Calendar
migrationCalendar.description: Historical pattern of species activity by month. Shows when each species typically appears at the feeder from data in the hub.

details.title: Monthly Pattern
details.content: Each row shows a species; columns are months (Jan–Dec). Numbers indicate visit counts. Darker cells = more activity in that month. The Σ column is the species total for your selected year range — that is your life-list style summary; there is no separate duplicate checklist.

details.title: Data Source
details.content: Uses all historical SpeciesVisit data. More data over multiple years gives a clearer migration pattern.

details.title: Species link
details.content: Click a species name to open its summary page with statistics and recent visits.

videoDetails.title: Video Details
videoDetails.description: View detailed information about recorded bird visits, including video footage, audio spectrograms, and detection results from both visual and audio analysis.

details.title: Media Player
details.content:
Above the player: arrows move between recordings for your browser’s local calendar day (ordered by start time). Past midnight, navigation can continue on the next or previous day.

When you open a clip from a Timeline visit card, previous/next step through sibling visits for that day (one step per visit card), using each visit’s primary clip — so the counter matches what you saw on the Timeline.

Two viewing modes:
- Video tab: recorded footage
- Audio tab: spectrogram
Timeline slider for precise navigation within the clip.

details.title: Detection Timeline
details.content:
Above the player:
- Current detections shown with bird thumbnail and confidence level
- Green badge (100%) indicates highest confidence detection
- Blue badge (95%+) shows high confidence detection
- Label indicates detection source (video/audio)

details.title: Detected Species
details.content:
Under "Detected Species" section:
- Species cards showing detected birds
- Number in parentheses shows detection count
- Confidence range for all detections
- Total duration of species presence
- "Learn More" links to detailed species information
- Correcting species here is the same action as on the Unknowns page for that detection (shared API); low-confidence rows may also appear under Unknowns until you confirm or correct.

details.title: General Information
details.content:
Technical details about the recording:
- Processor version used for analysis
- Start and end timestamps
- Total recording duration
- Processing details and settings

details.title: Weather Context
details.content:
Weather conditions during recording:
- Temperature in Celsius
- Cloud cover percentage
- Humidity level
- Wind speed
- Weather description (e.g., Mist)
Helps correlate bird activity with environmental conditions

details.title: Audio Analysis
details.content:
Spectrogram visualization shows:
- Bird calls and songs as color patterns
- Frequency range on vertical axis
- Time progression on horizontal axis
- Identified species labeled on the visualization
Helps verify audio-based species identification
